answer_1.quote: We investigate four types of guidance signals... we evaluate our methods on 6 popular summarization benchmarks.

answer_2.quote: Our best model... can achieve 1.28/0.79/1.13 ROUGE-1/2/L improvements... We also compute the METEOR scores.

answer_4.quote: We randomly sample 100 datapoints from the test set and ask 3 people from Amazon Mechanical Turk to evaluate their factual correctness. Each person gives a score between 1 and 3, with 3 being perfectly faithful to the source document.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate factual correctness on a 1–3 scale.
